direction: User correction: follow supplied Hearthstone screenshot, no invented wood/material style. Actual UI textures, not mockups.

assets.prompt:
Use the provided Hearthstone main menu screenshot as a STRICT visual reference. Produce a blank production game UI background from its carved wooden cabinet, faithfully matching its painting style, palette and finish. 16:9 landscape opaque image.
Remove EVERY button, banner, text, icon, emblem, logo, card pack, user interface overlay, watermark and screenshot viewer frame. Keep only the physical wooden cabinet.
Adapt its geometry to serve a wide empty interactive play area: huge broad recessed muted chestnut-brown central wooden surface covering 88% width and 86% height. Around the edges retain the reference's thick sculpted dark brown casing, wide curved bevels, a few large angular inset corner joins, and subdued warm pale edge accents. Center is gently shaded warm muted wood with ONLY a few extremely faint broad wavy grain strokes, completely calm and unobstructed. No central circle, no inlaid logo, no groove crossing the central play area.
Match the screenshot's SMOOTH HAND-PAINTED surfaces, softly blocked brushwork, muted brown/lavender shadows and warm taupe planes. Do not replace with raw timber, photographic grain, coarse noise, suede, teal cloth, desk props or generic realistic wood. The reference itself defines the material, lighting and style. Upper-left light; corners quietly shaded. Background contrast must support foreground cards.

Create ONE blank production UI panel using the exact Hearthstone material painting in the supplied screenshot. Strict reference: the massive carved muted brown frame surrounding the CENTRAL ROUND MENU, and its smooth dark brown recessed planes. Do not use natural wood photography or invent raw walnut, felt, leather, stitches or rivets.
Adapt that frame into a front-facing SQUARE panel for nine-slice UI: straight parallel sides, broad clipped rounded corners, frame thickness 10% of canvas. Keep the reference's chunky softened bevel cross-section: wide muted taupe-brown face, dark chocolate outer side, narrow deep inner recess, sparse pale warm directional edge accents that taper and break. Match its smooth painterly lavender-brown shadows and broad warm middle tones. The corner transitions are large sculpted planes, not little ornaments. Only a few very faint sweeping broad strokes suggest carved wood; no pores or noisy grain.
Fill the center with a uniform quiet deep muted brown painted inset (#39322e), no patterns or objects. It should read like the same carved menu housing in the screenshot, built into a square instead of a circle. Soft stylized game painting at the same visual finish as the reference. NOT a realistic render.
Single complete square asset, 96% canvas coverage, TRUE transparent outside. No text, logo, spiral, buttons, jewels, silver scrollwork, woodgrain streaks, distressed surface or decorative additions.

Create a production-ready blank UI button directly matching the central menu buttons in the supplied Hearthstone screenshot. The screenshot is the strict visual reference. Do not invent a new style, different material or wood texture.
Reconstruct ONE of the central gold-rimmed stone inset buttons (the one labeled 酒馆战棋), with all lettering removed. Match its painted gray-lavender stone face, wide muted ochre-gold bevel, dark brown recessed outer socket, chunky polygonal corners and small irregular painted edge accents. The face is smooth and softly shaded with broad hand-painted planes, NOT grainy, NOT rough wood, NOT suede. Match the reference's contrast, controlled pale highlight along the top bevel and dark lower thickness. Keep the reference's confident soft game painting, not a photorealistic render.
Only adaptation: make top and bottom edges exactly parallel and the left/right ends symmetric for reusable nine-slice, retain slightly slanted chunky corner cuts. WIDE horizontal button, 3:1 image. Complete object fills 96% width and 80% height, centered. True transparent alpha outside the button. Large blank center. No letters, logo, icons, emblem, background, extra buttons, photographic texture, added decoration or blue/green material.

Reconstruct ONE blank secondary button directly from the supplied Hearthstone screenshot's horizontal gray side buttons labeled 日志 / 商店 / 我的收藏. Strictly match their hand-painted smooth charcoal-gray body, broad softly shaded upper bevel, subdued warm-gray metal edge, deep brown-black underside and slight painted surface variation. No added wood grain. No invented suede. No jewel-like gloss.
Adapt the bar to a self-contained symmetric wide horizontal rectangle with subtly clipped small corners, top and bottom straight for nine-slice. Both ends are complete simple beveled ends. Remove all icons, medallions, lettering, symbols and logos. A large calm dark gray blank face for white text. Match reference color and level of detail exactly, a smooth soft painting of a solid object, not a photorealistic metal render.
ONE complete isolated asset on true transparent alpha, wide 3:1 canvas. Fill 96% width and 70% height with small transparent outer padding. No background, other buttons, gold filigree, rivets, inset ornament, excessive shine or fine texture.
